mapper.sql: select work_id, work_name, work_type, genre, synopsis, manuscript, status, owner_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_novel_work
mapper.insert: insert into ai_novel_work (work_name, work_type, genre, synopsis, manuscript, status, owner_user_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{workName}, #{workType}, #{genre}, #{synopsis}, #{manuscript}, #{status}, #{ownerUserId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
